children.description: The content areas (optional) to be split. The control will show n-1 splitter bars between n controls in this aggregation.

className.description:
CSS Class Name which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, overwriting CSS rules might break the component.

onResize.description:
Fired when contents are resized.

__Note:__
- Resize events can fire many times in quick succession, it’s therefore strongly recommended to debounce your handler if you’re updating React state or causing other expensive operations.
- The `areas` array reflects the logical position of the `SplitterElement`s relative to the "Splitter".

options.description: Defines options to customize the behavior of the SplitterLayout.

style.description:
Element style which will be appended to the most outer element of a component.
Use this prop carefully, some css properties might break the component.

vertical.description: Controls if a vertical or horizontal `SplitterLayout` is rendered.
